t: Mi hem hakkesherim liktob tepillin veliqnot mehem
s: Mi hem hakkesherim liktob tepillin veliqnot mehem ubo y"a seipim: tepillin shekketaban ebed kenaani, o ishsha, o qatan apillu hu ben y"g shanim ella sheeno yadua bevadday shehebi b' searot, vaadayin eno ben y"ch shana shennukal lomar min hassetam hebi kebar b' searot, o shekketaban nokri, o kuti apillu ketaban beperush lishman, o ketaban yisrael mumar lekol hattora apillu leteabon, o apillu laabera achat ella sheenah leteabon, ella mippene sheeno choshesh aleha kelal, kegon sheyyesh lepanayv hetter veissur umeniach hahetter veokel et haissur, o shekketaban masor apillu hu masor leteabon — pesulin, mippene shenneemar: "uqeshartam…uketabtam" — kol sheyyeshno biqshira, dehaynu shemmuzhar aleha umaamin bah — yeshno biktiba, vekol sheeno biqshira — eno biktiba, veebed veishsha venokri enan muzharin al qeshira, veqatan ap al pi shemmuzhar al haqqeshira middibre soperim lechanneko bemitzvot — eno muzhar aleha min hattora (vegam middibre soperim en haazhara ella al abiv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shamag). Umumar umasor — ap al pi shehem muzharin aleha, mikkol maqom kevan shepparequ ol bevadday enam maaminim bemitzvot. Veyesh omerim sheppesul hammumar laabera achat mippene sheeno choshesh aleha, vehammasor — hu middibre soperim, shehechemiru alehem chakamim laasotam kenokrim hoil uparequ mealehem ol mitzva. Abal mumar lekol hattora kullah apillu leteabon — pasul middibre tora ledibre hakkol, shehare hu kenokri lekol debarayv, kevan sheyyatza min hakkelal. Vaapillu im eno ella mumar laaboda zara, o lechallel et hashshabbat beparhesya — hu kenokri lekol debarayv, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman b. Veken im hu mumar lehakis apillu ledabar echad lebad — hare hu kenokri lekol hattora, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Umi sheeno meniach tepillin apillu eno oseh lehakis — pasul min hattora ledibre hakkol, shehare eno biqshira. Vehu sheeno menichan mippene sheeno choshesh alehem kelal, abal im eno menichan leteabon kegon sheholek achar asaqayv — kasher liktob. Veen tzarik lomar mi sheeno menichan mippene sheen yakol lahanichan, kegon shenniqtea yado hassemalit, shekkasher liktob, shehare muzhar hu al hattepillin umaamin bemitzvatan, ella sheeno yakol lahanichan mechamat onso:

Ger shechazar ledato mechamat yira vekoteb tepillin lishman — yesh makshirim. Veyesh poselim, mippene sheeno biqshira, shehare epshar lo lehaniach tepillin betzina veeno meniach. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem beshel tora:

Kol sheppasul lekotban — pasul lekol tiqqun asiyyatan, kesheoseh maaseh begup hattepillin, kegon laasot chippuy habbattim o letopran. Abal leabbedan — kasher, apillu nokri im meabbed lishmo kemo shennitbaer besiman lab. Veim echad mehappesulin chippan babbattim o teparan — pesulim mippene hashshi"n shel shem shebbabbattim shel rosh, shehu biklal chippuy utepira. Abal im garar debeq shebben ot leot o asa shear tiqqun — kasher bediabad. Vehu haddin im tapar seper tora:
Tepillin shekketaban min, dehaynu haaduq laaboda zara — yissarepu, shessetam machashebet min — laaboda zara:
Nimtzeu beyad min veeno yadua mi ketaban — yigganezu missapeq, shemma hu ketaban, abal en sorepin missapeq:

Nimtzeu beyad nokri veen yadua mi ketaban — kesherim, apillu lehammachamirim beseper tora shennimtza beyad nokri vechosheshim shemma hu ketabam kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman rapa, lepi shebbeseper tora yesh lachosh shemma ketabo leatzmo lehitlammed bo, abal tepillin en darkan lekotban, ubevadday bau leyado miyyisrael, veeno domeh lemin dilel besaip h, shehammin hu yodea liktob, veyesh lachosh shemma era miqreh shekkatab gam tepillin ap al pi sheen lo tzorek bahen, abal setam nokrim enam yekolim liktob, ella shebbeseper tora chayshinan shemma era echad sheyyodea liktob vekatab seper tora kede lehitlammed betokah, abal en lachosh kol-kak shemma era echad sheyyodea liktob veera shekkatab gam tepillin, sheen lo tzorek bahem:

En loqechin separim tepillin umezuzot min hannokri yoter mikkede demehem harbeh, bikde shello lehargilam legonban ulegozlan. Abal mechuyyabim liqnotan mehem meat yoter mikkede demehen, shello yezalzelu bahen. Velo yomar lehannokri sheyyimkerem bedabar muat meod, pen yikos hannokri veyashlikem leibbud:

En loqechin tepillin ella min hammumcheh shebbaqi bachaserot viterot, abal lo mimmi sheeno mumcheh ap al pi shehu rotzeh lebodqan, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma yitatztzel bibdiqatan, mippene shettorach hu lo lehasir hattepira velachazor uletopran:

Laqach mimmi sheeno mumcheh — bodeq bachaserot viterot. Veen lachosh shemma ibbedan shello lishman, mippene shehakkol beqiim bazeh. Veen tzarik libdoq kullan, ella apillu laqach mimmennu mea qetzitzot — day sheyyibdoq shalosh qetzitzot, shettayim shel rosh veachat shel yad, o shettayim shel yad veachat shel rosh, im metzaan kesherot — huchzaq zeh haish vahare kullan kesherot, veen hashshear tzerikin bediqa. Veim laqach tzebatim tzebatim — chezqatan shemmissoperim harbeh hem loqechim, lepikak tzarik libdoq mikkol tzebet shettayim shel rosh veachat shel yad, o shettayim shel yad veachat shel rosh:
Hammoker tepillin veomer shehayu shel adam gadol — neeman, sheed echad neeman beissurin, veshub en tzarik bediqa, shechazaqa al chaber shello hotzi mittachat yado dabar sheeno metuqqan:

Tepillin shehuchzequ bekashrut paam achat — enam tzerikim bediqa leolam min haddin, shekkol zeman shechippuyan shalem — hare hen bechezqatan, veen chosheshin shemma nimchaqa ot mittokan o niqqeba. Umikkol maqom, nakon lebodqan, mippene shemmitqalqelim min hazzea. Veim en menichan ella lipraqim — tzerikin bediqa paamayim besheba shanim, sheyyesh lachosh shemma nitappeshu. Veken im niqra hachippuy — tzerikin bediqa. Veken im nishru bammayim. Veim en lo mi sheyyodea lebodqan velachazor uletopran — yenichen kak belo bediqa shello yitbattel mimmitzvat tepillin.
